ideas.title: Investigating the Impact of the Government Shutdown on Immigration Services
ideas.description: This story would investigate how the partial government shutdown has affected immigration services, including those provided by ICE and the Department of Homeland Security.
questions: How has the shutdown impacted immigration services?
What are the financial implications of the shutdown on these services?
ideas.insight: I believe that this story is crucial in understanding the human impact of the government shutdown. By investigating the effects on immigration services, we can shed light on the potential consequences of the shutdown and hold those in power accountable.
